scope: EXPERIMENTAL worker-scoped strong Map registries in the immutable qualification host helper only. All original game source bytes remain unchanged. One fixed callback-only fixture, three warmups then twenty measured battles; no broad battle/scene qualification or speed claim.

replacementProof.reason: The sole edit replaces one exact known host-membrane IIFE. Every byte outside that host helper, and every other source unit, is unchanged; original module/helper source inputs remain separately pinned.

oracleProfile.wholeBattleContextReason: Reflect the real VM global object with ordinary Script var/function binding descriptors; contextified sandbox wrappers change configurability and hide uninitialized bindings from parent reflection.
oracleProfile.reason: Default JIT tiers and --no-opt produced different NaN bits for identical source and inputs. --jitless was stable across all six cold/warmed probe processes.
oracleProfile.throughputPolicy: Performance measurements may use compiled native candidates or separately identified runtime flags. Qualification compares candidate traces against this pinned source profile; measurements alone do not establish equivalence.
oracleProfile.scope: Reproducible reference implementation profile, not a claim that ECMAScript specifies NaN sign/payload or that all engine versions produce identical bits.

limitations: Text matches do not establish lexical binding identity or reachability. No claim follows solely from substring absence: constructed names, aliases, eval/Function-generated code, downloaded scripts and native injected APIs are not resolved.
The audit does not establish absence of native finalizers or GC-visible Cocos lifetime effects. Explicit native ownership calls are inventoried separately, not removed or normalized.
Harness WeakMaps and VM collector implementation are outside these18 originals. WeakMap has no standard iteration, but this audit does not prove every external weak consumer is unobservable.

Each heap/young-generation/GC runtime configuration still requires the unchanged strict battle report and input-consumption gate; broad ordered trace and full-scene/random-roster qualification remain separate.

ownershipArgument: The native worker loader assigns __nativeTables once from the pinned JSON bundle and has no eviction. Every decoded raw root remains reachable through that binding for the single process/batch lifetime.

Immutable graph edges cannot change through exposed table proxies. Under the bounded loader domain, every raw descendant remains strongly reachable from a leased root, so records Map does not add a raw-key lifetime.
Each created proxy is already strongly retained by record.proxy while its raw key is reachable. proxies Map therefore adds no proxy-key lifetime within the worker lease.
The register-local graph map never escapes; pending retains its raw keys throughout external validation/digest callbacks.

Captured Map constructor and bound native get/has/set operations do not consult later mutable Map/Function prototype method properties. Generic root wrapping and parsing are rejected; this helper is not promoted as a generic library.

The lease and source audit are bounded to this supplied-source worker. Arbitrary host raw aliases, reflection into added harness globals, cross-worker reuse, root eviction and hostile pre-bootstrap intrinsic replacement are outside this experimental domain.
leaseChecks: Every wrap requires an approved immutable table name and exact own data-root identity in the retained __nativeTables object.
A replaced worker root-set binding fails sticky qualification.
Generic parse and roots outside the loader bundle fail sticky qualification.
intrinsicCaptureOrdering: The helper captures trusted host-bootstrap Map/call/bind identities at its IIFE evaluation. This is a bounded harness-domain assumption, not a test that arbitrary pre-mutated globals are pristine; hostile pre-bootstrap extensions are unsupported.
cancellationReason: The candidate Node process reached ~2GiB RSS while concurrent8GiB nativeGC trial used ~5.9GiB RSS and cgroupusage reached ~15.9GB. Agent killed ONLY its own Node proof to preserve native trial; no OOM or semantic mismatch established.
